note: H253: WN18RR official split carries 34.97% same-pair leakage -- more than the 30.01% FB15k-237 shuffle this fleet refused to gate on -- and G92's entire margin over the null lives inside it.

controls.name: C1_both_published_numbers_reproduce
controls.must_fire_because: G92's 0.3611 and G105's 0.0256 are both re-derived here from their own code, so this attack drove the instruments under test rather than retyped copies of them (family C)
controls.can_fail_because: either fails to reproduce, meaning a different model

controls.name: C2_partition_is_exhaustive_and_disjoint
controls.must_fire_because: every number below is one subset arithmetic error away from meaningless: leaked + clean must equal the test set, and their query counts must equal 6,268
controls.can_fail_because: the subsets do not sum to n_test or 2 * n_test

controls.name: C3_the_partition_is_not_inert
controls.must_fire_because: a partition that scored the same on both halves would make every comparison here vacuous
controls.can_fail_because: leaked and clean MRRs are within 0.01

controls.name: C4_the_null_can_move
controls.must_fire_because: F1 claims the null does NOT move when the leak is deleted from train. That is only evidence if it CAN move: restricting the population moves it +0.0127 while the deletion moves it 0.0000
controls.can_fail_because: the null is constant across populations too, in which case F1 is unfalsifiable (A15)

controls.name: C5_subsetting_itself_does_not_move_scores
controls.must_fire_because: _hypernym is 0.2% leaked and 40% of the test set. If the act of subsetting moved scores, it would move too. full 0.0116 vs clean 0.0116 -- so the leaked/clean gap is the leak and not the slicing
controls.can_fail_because: _hypernym moves materially between full and clean

falsifiers.name: F1_wn18rr_null_is_blind_to_the_leak_too
falsifiers.can_fail_because: deleting every leak-creating edge from train moves the null far less than a population change does
falsifiers.refutes: that G105's 0.0256 might itself be leak-inflated
falsifiers.fires_when: deleting every leak-creating edge from train moves the null far less than a population change does

falsifiers.name: F2_the_margin_lives_in_the_leaked_subset
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the multiple over the null on the NON-leaked triples falls below 1.0, i.e. the null wins there
falsifiers.null_must_contain: clean subset still beats the null
falsifiers.refutes: G105's 14.1x as evidence the system works on WN18RR
falsifiers.fires_when: the multiple over the null on the NON-leaked triples falls below 1.0, i.e. the null wins there

falsifiers.name: F3_the_leak_is_spread_rather_than_concentrated
falsifiers.can_fail_because: one relation supplies more than 80% of the leaked triples
falsifiers.refutes: that a single relation explains it, which would make the finding a number with no mechanism
falsifiers.fires_when: one relation supplies more than 80% of the leaked triples

falsifier: the non-leaked subset still beating the null, or the null moving when every leak-creating edge is deleted from train, or _hypernym moving between the full and clean arms
